issues.title: A validator a few per cent slower at execution is demoted under load, because its commit waits on its own execution
Engine execution caps chain throughput at about 215 µs per transaction
A promoted validator cannot rebuild its DAG mid-epoch, so it loops between promotion and demotion until the next epoch
MDBX WRITEMAP commit dirties whole large page-cache folios: about 4× bench 4's device bytes per transaction
At light load the two European validators drift behind the round and most of their certificates are never committed
Under load the fastest executors' headers are refused as execution-behind, so up to f validators lose every certificate
A lagging node's signer-recovery jobs land on top of its own block builds, so the lag feeds itself
A loaded epoch close waits for the seventh-fastest validator's execution backlog; slower members miss the epoch record
A sealed transaction leaves the pool and the RPC, so a skipped one waits 5 minutes for a resend and a resend runs twice
